Hi Martin

On November 1, EU customs will block any product shipped without three required product identifiers and many products in your catalog are still missing them. If your catalog isn’t complete by November 1, your EU orders will not be compliant to clear customs.

Start today:
* Follow our setup guide<····> to create the fields needed.
* Email your suppliers for manufacturer references now. This step takes the longest.
* Fill in your top-selling EU products first.

If you have any questions, please reach out to (email hidden)<mailto:(email hidden)>

The F. Team
[····]
